identification: American-style Victorian hanging library (pendant) oil lamp c1885-1900: polished copper centre-draft font with brass filigree band and pierced brass draft-tube cap underneath, brass centre-draft burner with gallery, cast brass scroll frame with Greek-key panels, pierced brass shade ring with prism hooks (no prisms), 14in-type plain white milk glass dome shade with open top, separate embossed brass ceiling canopy now fitted with a bulb holder (electrified canopy), plus a loose brass ring (probably the smoke-bell/shade crown ring). Chains present. Miller attribution is the catalogue's only; nothing in the photos confirms maker (Miller, Bradley & Hubbard, Plume & Atwood and others made near-identical lamps).

viewing_check: Look for EDW. MILLER & CO / Meriden stamp on burner thumbwheel, font collar and frame; check font for dents and that the centre-draft tube is intact; check shade rim for chips and hairlines; confirm the ceiling canopy/bulb fitting and loose ring belong; count missing prism hooks/prisms; check smoke bell present.
